import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import

def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c

def expect_value_error(fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

# basic insert
c = fresh()
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.co", "name": " Alice "}, {"email": "B@C.co", "name": "Bob"}]) == {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.co", "Alice"), ("b@c.co", "Bob")]

# update existing (even unchanged name)
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "A@B.CO", "name": "Alice"}, {"email": " b@c.co ", "name": "Bobby"}]) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 2}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.co", "Alice"), ("b@c.co", "Bobby")]

# trimming and whitespace handling
c = fresh()
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "  A@B.CO  ", "name": "\tAnn "}]) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.co", "Ann")]

# empty batch
c = fresh()
assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == []

# validation: whole batch rejected, nothing written
bad_batches = [
    ["not an object"],
    [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "extra": 1}],
    [{"email": "a@b"}],
    [{"name": "A"}],
    [{"email": 1, "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": "a@b", "name": 5}],
    [{"email": "ab", "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": "a@@b", "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": "@b", "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": "a@", "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": "a b@b", "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": " a\tb@b", "name": "A"}],
    [{"email": "a@b", "name": "   "}],
    [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}, {"email": "A@B", "name": "B"}],
    [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}, "junk"],
]
for rows in bad_batches:
    c = fresh()
    expect_value_error(lambda rows=rows: import_contacts(c, rows))
    assert list_contacts(c) == [], rows

# non-list rows
expect_value_error(lambda: import_contacts(fresh(), {"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}))

# API envelope
c = fresh()
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}]}) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
for payload in [None, [], "s", {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": "s"}, {"contacts": [1]}, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}]:
    expect_value_error(lambda c=c, p=payload: handle_import(c, p))

# existing API preserved
c = fresh()
assert handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}) == {"ok": True}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice")]

# database failure leaves everything unchanged and connection idle
c = fresh()
import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}])
import src.repository as repository
original = repository.put_contact
calls = []
def flaky(connection, email, name):
    calls.append(email)
    if len(calls) == 2:
        raise sqlite3.OperationalError("boom")
    original(connection, email, name)
repository.put_contact = flaky
import src.service as service
service.put_contact = flaky
try:
    import_contacts(c, [{"email": "n1@b", "name": "N1"}, {"email": "n2@b", "name": "N2"}])
except sqlite3.OperationalError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("expected OperationalError")
finally:
    repository.put_contact = original
    service.put_contact = original
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "A")]
assert not c.in_transaction

print("all import checks passed")
